title: Cardano Native Token Extension: Programmable Tokens

ms.promise:
A draft of the Design document, available as an open-source Github repository. The design document will contain:
・Description of current known research of programmable tokens on Cardano and on the other chains.
・Description and analysis of our design of the programmable tokens, thorough examination and a walkthrough with diagrams
・Integration of our new token type with the common transactions in the eUTxO model.
・Research of pros and cons of our programmable tokens and other kinds of programmable tokens.
・Description of implementation of functionalities that are possible to be built on top of our model, s.a. transfer fees, address blacklisting, and token freezing.
ms.criteria:
The draft of the document contains our design of the on-chain architecture and diagrams for programmable tokens. The document contains:
・Description of current known research of programmable tokens
・Description and analysis of our design of the programmable tokens
・Integration of our new token type with the common transactions in the eUTxO model.
・Research of pros and cons of our programmable tokens and other kinds of programmable tokens.
・Description of functionalities that are possible to be built on top of our model, s.a. transfer fees, address blacklisting, and token freezing.
ms.report:
Everything can be seen in an open source GitHub repository: https://github.com/vacuumlabs/programmable-tokens-research
Most notably, the whitepaper PDF file can be accessed here: https://github.com/vacuumlabs/programmable-tokens-research/blob/main/whitepaper.pdf

Added

・Introduction describing the motivation, current research and our approach.

From the Changelog:
Version 0.2 (Milestone 2) - [2024-08-27]
Added
・We added the second version of the whitepaper, including:
・The integration of programmable tokens with wallets. Recognizing programmable tokens both off-chain and on-chain, an idea on how to construct transactions featuring programmable tokens and other relevant recommendations.
・The integration of programmable tokens with existing and future dApps. Includes a thorough commentary on the new smart contract considerations and possibly new attack vectors that need to be thought-about.
・Template-based programmable tokens. An idea and a design that allows reusing programmable checks for multiple projects with the possibility of setting project-based parameters.

ms.promise: Open-source, well-documented proof of concept validator(s) (on-chain) and off-chain test cases demonstrating the specified functionalities.
ms.criteria:
The code will showcase a freezable Cardano native token. The validators will be well documented and tested. We will also showcase following functionalities on the Cardano testnet:
・Minting the tokens
・Transfer of token from wallet A to wallet B
・Freezing of tokens by administrator
・Unfreezing of tokens by administrator.
